honest_c3: hexa-lang ML production-readiness is years of work; mk2 EOL gate is < 1 cycle. Phase 1 alone (6.3k LoC) is 2-4 weeks focused engineering. Recommendation: do not gate mk2 EOL on hexa-only Phase 1-5 completion.
PyTorch parity at full ML scale is unrealistic; pragmatic scope = inference + eval only (Phase 1-3). Phase 4-5 (training, distill) at production quality = years.
Some primitives need C extension layer not pure hexa: IEEE-754 reinterpret-cast (achievable via frexp/ldexp but slow); fast bf16 matmul (needs SIMD/BLAS); production attention (needs fused kernel).

GPU memory mgmt + bf16 numerics + autograd = three of the hardest hexa challenges combined. PyTorch's success rests on validated CUDA caching allocator + numerical kernel zoo + tape autograd handling broadcast/in-place/non-differentiable. hexa-lang has partial surface for each but no validated end-to-end at transformer scale.

Migration cost asymmetric: full Path A retrain via hexa-only ~100k+ LoC; Mode 1 eval-only via hexa ~30-50k LoC; current Mode 1 via .py shim ~200 LoC of glue. Tradeoff: language purity vs months of engineering against moving HF ecosystem.

fixtures/transpile/case_*.expected.py discovery: hexa→py transpiler is partially landed upstream. Realistic alternative path = land hexa→py transpiler ML rules (~5-15k LoC) instead of full reimplementation. May be the actual unlock.
hexa-lang LoRA CUDA RC_ERR_CUDA_TODO=-5 status as of 2026-05-04 not re-verified. Anima-side spike to query hexa-lang .roadmap recommended before committing Phase 4 estimates.
biggest_unlock_summary: Phase 1 (HF Hub I/O + safetensors numeric + sentencepiece + Llama BPE pretrained-load) at ~6.3k LoC unlocks 'load any HF model in pure hexa' which is the foundation for Phase 2-3. This is the single highest-leverage PR.
